claims.statement: Management expects to reach a capacity closer to 150,000 metric tons for VAE over a period of about 2-2.5 years.
claims.quote: Our feeling is that possibly over a period of about 2-2.5 years, we should be able to reach basically a capacity which is higher and closer to about 150,000 MT.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects the VAE backward integration project to translate into a 300-500 basis points margin band for the relevant product categories.
claims.quote: Generally, overall, for the category of products it would translate into that 300-500 basis points band.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states the goal to maintain operating margins within the band they have been operating on going ahead.
claims.quote: Going ahead, the whole idea is that we can still maintain a band of what we have been operating on.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management intends not to take price increases going forward unless the situation becomes alarming.
claims.quote: Ideally, we would not like to take any increases going forward unless the situation really becomes alarming of what we need to do in certain categories, if it really comes to the point of doing so.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects the strategy going forward to maintain decent growth in each segment, along with upgrading consumers from unorganized to organized and economic to premium/luxury.
claims.quote: As we go ahead, we are going to maintain the focus that in each of the segments we have a decent growth. At the same time, there is a lot of imperative that we are able to upgrade the consumer
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects competitive intensity to continue to remain as they go ahead.
claims.quote: My estimate is that the competitive intensity will continue to remain as we go ahead.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The company has an ongoing VAM-VAE backward integration project with an indicated capacity of 150,000 metric tons.
facts.quote: How should one think about this 150,000 metric ton VAE capacity versus your potential requirement on the current scale of business?

facts.statement: Input costs went up by almost 25% while price increases were to the tune of 9%, 10% or 11%.
facts.quote: costs have gone up by almost 25% and if we consider that costs broadly remain where they are and the price increase has been to the tune of 9%, 10% or 11%

facts.statement: Putty is considered the starting point of paints and signifies the first purchase a consumer makes for painting.
facts.quote: Putty is a starting point of paints. That segment is also important because it really signifies that it’s the first purchase a consumer is doing as far as painting is concerned.

facts.statement: Second-quarter margins are relatively lower compared to other quarters due to the product mix.
facts.quote: if you see quarter two, relatively speaking, the margins are little bit lower as compared to what we get in other quarters, given the product mix that we speak of.
